# Changelog - mirror-fork-pr

## 1.0.0

Initial release. This skill requires a security approval gate, commit-by-commit
inspection, a pinned source SHA, individual cherry-picks, guarded refreshes,
and post-merge attribution follow-up. These checks prevent unreviewed fork
content from gaining first-party CI privileges or silently replacing an
approved revision. See the [maintainer guide](../../../acl/docs/cherry-pick-from-fork.md)
for the workflow overview.
